title: Inventory of an archive
question: What is inside {input}/release.zip? How many files, which is the largest once unpacked, which two files have identical content, and what is the SHA-256 of config/defaults.env?

fields.file_count: integer: the number of files in the archive
fields.largest_file: string: the path of the file that is largest once unpacked
fields.identical_files: array of two strings: the paths of the two files with identical content
fields.defaults_env_sha256: string: the SHA-256 of config/defaults.env, as lower-case hex

notes: The inventory counts the archive itself as one occurrence: ten occurrences are nine files. Two paths that share one artifact id have identical content.
